regime_context: China A-shares: momentum rank-IC ~0, absolute trend gate did not reduce drawdown historically; the market is mean-reverting and the detector offers no predictive edge. The only eligible theme is a narrow Semiconductors leadership with moderate durability and low breadth, while macro headlines are AI/tech-heavy but coincident. All directional leans are necessarily low-conviction, conditional, and anchored to trend persistence rather than any forecast.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (cn_ai_compute) challenging Semiconductors for top rank. Watch for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff: (1) its rank rises to 1, (2) durability_bar sustains above 0.5, (3) breadth >0.3, and (4) the lead margin vs. Semiconductors holds for 5 consecutive days. Kill-criterion: Semiconductors re-establishes a durable lead (margin >0.2) within the watch period.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is the sole theme with a persistent absolute trend (eligibility true, hurst_tag trend, durability_bar >0.5) and no crowding. In a momentum-driven allocation framework it demands a positive lean, though the historical failure of the absolute trend gate in this market means we treat this as a conditional, fragile trend-following posture, not a reward forecast.
theses.dissent: The market's mean-reverting character and the backtested failure of the absolute trend gate to cut drawdown here warn that this trend could quickly reverse; the low breadth (0.364) and narrow rotation suggest the leadership is fragile, and a single policy shock could unwind Semiconductors as it did in past cycles.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors loses eligibility (eligible flips to false) OR durability_bar drops below 0.4 on any daily close within the next 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
